# `cube::Field`

[Game reference](../README.md) › [world](../world.md) › `cube::Field`

- **Kind:** class, 0x20 bytes
- **Status:** verified (source: kyubu)
- **Builds:** Cube.exe, Server.exe only
- **C:** `cube_Field` in `cubeworld/types.h`
- **Lua:** `cubeworld.cast("cube_Field", address)`
- **Evidence:** `manual:getField returns cube::Zone.fields + 0x20 * column`, `xref:cube::World::getBlock`

one block column of a zone: blocks from base_z up, size of them. Below base_z the game answers a solid block; above the column, water at z 0 and below, else air
